sv.title: Inbrott i Kate och Williams semesterhem
sv.summary: Det brittiska kronprinsparet William och Kate hade inbrott i sitt semesterhem i Norfolk på måndagskvällen, rapporterar The Sun.

en.title: Burglary at Kate and William's holiday home
en.summary: The British Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Kate, had a burglary at their holiday home in Norfolk on Monday evening, reports The Sun.
